routes.name: Co'ver
routes.desc: Sit start on the left flake. Up onto powerful crimping to hit the gritty sloper rail, then finish up the committing mantle to the easy slab. Take big pads or good spotters or both. This is the king line of Koh Tao.

routes.name: Tantalis
routes.desc: The original line set by Matt Pearson in 2010. There has been confusion as to which line is Tantalis, and has been recently confused with the FA of "Co'ver" by Onsight climbing in 2015. Sit start at the far left flake, big crux move traversing right between the sloping rails then up and right, around the prow. Cool mantle finish to stand up below the slab. Pad on up or step off behind onto a boulder. FA: 2010

routes.name: Planet Paradise
routes.desc: Same sit start as Tantalis, but straight up the crimps to slopey but gritty rail to traverse to the same mantle finish of Tantalis. FA: 2010

routes.name: Pinatubo

routes.name: Little Marino
routes.desc: Start on the same sloper of 'Pinatubo', and finish the traverse line of 'Tantalis'. This line avoids the reachy crux of 'Tantalis', giving a sustained problem for the grade.

routes.name: I'm from Altamira
routes.desc: The line of weakness. Is also the descent route. This collection of boulders is on the left-hand side of the road and right next to the parking. Bizzaro and Fingertip Ascent faces the road, while brujo boulder sits above on the small knoll, and Letterbox, around the other side. From the Letterbox boulder, across the grass, you can see the spaceship boulder and 'the vine intervention' highball. All within 10-20m of each other.

routes.name: Dory
routes.desc: Low start from the ledge. Over the bulge using the side of the cracks. Area further up the hill from the parking spot, easily accessed from the main secret garden area (courtyard) following the bush up hill, you will see a highball boulder with an obvious crack trending right and up, and behind that, another highball called 'Jawaship Boulder' with 'pancake ninja - V6'. The majority of the area has unnamed boulder problems but lots to go at for some fun, and development potential. Also home to the 'James and the Giant Peach - V11' boulder.

routes.name: Scuba Diver
routes.desc: Centre face highball on the 'Jawaship Boulder'. Stand start, crimp two crystals and stab crimp higher up. Holds get briefly better then a bit worse then you're jugging at the top. Good feet all the way. Lovely sequence.
